title: ClaimEvidenceLinkV1
description: Machine-auditable lineage record tying a canonical claim to its runtime evidence, deploy evidence, integration evidence, approval artifact, policy delta, and verification checklist. Wire-stable as claim_evidence_link.v1. See contract/PROPOSALS/004-claims-evidence-links.md.

version.description: Discriminator. Must be exactly 'claim_evidence_link.v1'. Breaking changes bump this value and live alongside v1.

link_id.description: Server-assigned stable identifier for this link (e.g. 'cel_01j9...').

claim_id.description: The canonical claim row this link annotates.

linked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this link was created.

runtime_evidence.description: Required. Summary of the DecisionReceipt produced by protectWithEvidence(). Contains the minimum fields needed to re-verify the permit offline.

permit_token.description: Opaque token returned by /v1-verify-permit. Used to re-verify the permit.

audit_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical decision payload.

decision.description: The authorization decision at evaluation time.

decision_id.description: Server-issued stable identifier for the decision.

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm used for the DecisionReceipt. 'none' when no signing secret was configured.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded signature over the receipt payload. Null when algorithm is 'none'.

deploy_evidence.description: Summary of the deploy gate record from protectDeploy(). Null when this claim does not relate to a deployment action.

sha.description: Git commit SHA or artifact digest being deployed.

actor_id.description: Identity of the agent or user that triggered the deployment.

gate_permit_token.description: The permit token issued by the deploy gate.

integration_evidence.description: Summary of the most recent ComplianceEvidenceRun covering the claim period. Null when no compliance run is linked to this claim.

framework.description: Compliance framework under which the run was executed.

status.description: Terminal status of the compliance run.

approval_artifact.description: Summary of the HITL chain or ApprovalArtifact that authorised this claim. Null when no human approval was required.

approval_id.description: Stable identifier of the approval artifact or HITL chain.

approval_kind.description: 'hitl_chain' for approvals via /v1/hitl; 'approval_artifact' for out-of-band signed artifacts.

approver_count.description: Number of distinct approvers who signed off.

approver_ids.description: Principal IDs of each approver, in approval order.

delta.description: Policy and schema drift since the claim was asserted. Server-computed; callers must not populate this field themselves.

computed_at.description: When this delta was computed. Re-computing after a policy change produces a fresh delta.

policy_version_at_claim.description: Policy version identifier active when the claim was made.

policy_version_current.description: Policy version identifier at delta-computation time.

policy_drift_detected.description: True when policy_version_at_claim != policy_version_current AND the change affects the rules governing this claim's action_type.

schema_version_at_claim.description: OpenAPI / wire-schema version active when the claim was made (e.g. 'openapi-2.14.0').

drift_details.description: Human-readable change summaries when any drift is detected. Empty array when no drift. Note: open question whether these should become structured objects — see proposal OQ 6.

verification_checklist.description: Machine-auditable pass/fail summary across all evidence slots. all_pass is the single boolean a downstream auditor queries first.

runtime_evidence_present.description: Always true for a well-formed link (runtime_evidence is required non-null).

runtime_evidence_verified.description: True when permit_token was successfully re-verified via /v1-verify-permit at computed_at. May become false after permit TTL elapses.

deploy_evidence_present.description: True when deploy_evidence is non-null. False means 'not applicable or missing' — see proposal OQ 5 for the distinction.

delta_computed.description: True when the delta slot was successfully computed by the server.

all_pass.description: True when runtime_evidence_present, runtime_evidence_verified, delta_computed, policy_drift_clean, and schema_drift_clean are all true. deploy_evidence_present, integration_evidence_present, and approval_artifact_present do NOT gate all_pass — their absence may be intentional (null = not applicable).

computed_at.description: Timestamp when the checklist was computed. Permit verification freshness is relative to this value.
